property_summary: For any role other than TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE (whose stored admin is itself), c.getRoleAdmin(role) returns the stored adminRole (bytes32(0) for unconfigured roles) and never equals the queried role itself; the mutant returns the role itself, breaking this for e.g. any unconfigured nonzero role.
change_summary: Return the queried role identifier itself instead of its stored adminRole.
